**q25.** CEL (Common Expression Language) engine via `cel-go`, at internal/filter/engine.go; the CEL expression is compiled into a dialect-agnostic condition tree (`internal/filter/parser.go`), then rendered to dialect-specific parameterized SQL by `internal/filter/render.go` — each DB driver calls `filter.AppendConditions` with `DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL` to produce WHERE-clause fragments.

**q26.** memo_relation, attachment, memo, memo_share (via ON DELETE CASCADE). At the handler level, comment memos are also recursively deleted first (each cascading through the same tables).

**q27.** Go `embed.FS` (`//go:embed dist/*`) served via Echo's `StaticWithConfig` middleware with SPA fallback; server/router/frontend/frontend.go

**q28.**
s3presign.Runner — time.Ticker every 12 hours (plus RunOnce at startup), started at server/server.go:162-170

Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` package (a full cron-style scheduler with parser, middleware, and job management) is present in the codebase but never imported or used by the server. Also, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` defines a `Runner` with a `RunOnce` batch method, but only its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is called inline during memo create/update — the runner itself is never started as a background worker.

**q29.** Interceptor: web/src/connect.ts:156 (authInterceptor); token kinds: JWT access tokens (short-lived, 15 min), refresh tokens (HTTP-only cookie, 30 days), and Personal Access Tokens (PAT); backend validation package: server/auth (authenticator.go)

**q30.**
memos.memo.created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
memos.memo.updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
memos.memo.deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
memos.memo.comment.created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook
All converge on webhook.PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go:184 (enqueues to asyncPostQueue; 4 goroutines drain it via webhook.Post at line 120)
